d: Watch Bollywood Classic Hit Song 'O Maheki Maheki Thandi Hawa Ye Bata' from the evergreen romantic adventure comedy drama movie 'Bombay To Goa' (1972) directed by S. Ramanathan. The movie stars Mehmood, Anwar Ali, Shatrughan Sinha, Amitabh Bachchan, Aruna Irani. The music is composed by R.D. Burman. This song is sung by Kishore Kumar.
